notes: Siltborn: gas-giant ring floaters, jellyfish-like; a FLOATING rig (kind "floating": 49x49, pivot (24,24)). No walk: the legs layer is a ruffled skirt and five wavy trailing tendrils with amber beads, drawn pointing back (down at rotation 0) and turned to the movement direction (`float`: 6 frames, 5 fps, a closed loop played by time; `stand`: the calm idle frame). The body (torso, head, arms) sits in the middle of the frame as a normal body and the drawer bobs it, so no bob is baked in: a translucent bell seen from above (a frilled, scalloped rim, a dithered glassy shoulder, eight radial canals, trapped bubbles), an amber gas sac in the crown (head layer) lighting it from inside, tentacle arms ending in a curl round the item. The mounts are the human's moved by (+8,+8). torso_glow (2 frames, ~2 fps) is the faint glow of the canals, head_glow (2 frames per head) the sac, legs_glow (one frame per legs frame) the tendril tips. Head variants: crown (a ring of cilia beads), bloom (six rose petals), helmet (a salvaged bubble helm). Outfit mask = the cloth sling across the bell and its streamer. Same rig as human: every layer faces UP at rotation 0 on one 49x49 frame, rotate about the pivot; outfit pixels are neutral grey in the base PNG and white in *_color.png (multiply by the outfit colour there); no baked shadow.

legs.notes: frames 0-5 are the float cycle (a closed loop played by time, whether or not they move), frame 6 the idle: this layer is what trails behind the body (drawn pointing back, turned to the movement direction)

arms.notes: item placement: item top-left = mount - item.grip (both unrotated), then rotate the upper group about the pivot. Mounts are identical on every species (and the human), so any item fits any body. Pose = the item's class: pistol, rifle, tool, heavy, melee. RIG KIND floating: this frame is 49x49 with the pivot at (24,24), so every mount here is the shared one moved by (+8,+8): mount - pivot is identical to the human rig.

glow.notes: per head variant, a list of glow frames: alternate them at 2 fps
